Fig. 6
The comparative effects of dietary patterns, speciﬁc foods and individual food components on inﬂammation. The dietary patterns, foods and
food components on the left push the pendulum of inﬂammation to the right (i.e., toward less inﬂammation) while the dietary pattern, foods and
food components on the right push the pendulum of inﬂammation to the left (i.e., towards more inﬂammation). AGEs, advanced glycated end
products; PUFAs, polyunsaturated fatty acids.
